title: KAN Jira transition allowlist (KAN-20, WI-04-6)
approval: Approved by Ojas Sharma 2026-10-04 07:28 IST (ADR-0017 status mapping): existing Jira workflow only (To Do / In Progress / In Review / Done); BLOCKED and REWORK are labels/comments, not statuses; agents may move work to In Progress / In Review per evidence; an agent must NEVER declare its own work Done; Done needs validation, required review, acceptance-criteria evidence and merge/release conditions (human approval for sensitive work). Everything listed under proposed_assumptions below is PROPOSED ASSUMPTION - REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL.
sources: ADR-0001 (KAN Jira workflow has four statuses)

human.description: A person acting in Jira (for example Ojas Sharma).

owner_agent.description: The agent that owns the work item (for example LR 04 Backend for KAN-20).

reviewer_agent.description: A reviewer, QA or security gate agent acting manually (ADR-0017 point 11 'reviewer, QA/security gate').

automation.description: Webhook, CI step, scheduled job, adapter or script (KAN-26/KAN-27). No such adapter exists yet.

exec-rework.approval: approved (Ojas Sharma, KAN-20 comments 10108/10113; removal when rework is complete: comment 10108)
exec-rework.meaning: Work returned to its owner for rework. Always together with status In Progress and an explicit comment. Free text label: never a permission.

blocked.meaning: BLOCKED is a label/comment, never a status (approved). ADR-0017 point 10 defines only a comment ('BLOCKED: <reason>', status unchanged); no label name has been decided, so none is written by this allowlist.

transitions.approval: approved in principle (agents may move to In Progress per evidence)
proposed_assumptions: evidence is 'claim record or first branch' (ADR-0017 point 11); field names claim_record/branch_name are this file's choice
automation may do it only once an adapter exists (KAN-26); until then it is manual

evidence_requirements.description: claim record or first branch (valid KAN branch name)

transitions.approval: approved in principle (agents may move to In Review per evidence)
proposed_assumptions: evidence is PR link and valid branch name (ADR-0017 point 11); only https PR URLs accepted by the validator

transitions.approval: approved: REWORK = In Progress + label exec-rework + explicit comment
proposed_assumptions: comment wording 'REWORK: reason: ...; evidence: ...; to complete: ...' (conventions page; ADR-0017 point 8 lists reason, evidence link and what completes the rework)
automation only on failed checks; owner_agent is not listed in ADR-0017 point 11 for this transition and is denied

transitions.approval: approved: exec-rework removed when rework is complete
proposed_assumptions: trigger = corrected PR has passing checks and review is re-requested (ADR-0017 point 8)

ADR-0017 point 11 writes this row as 'In Review -> In Progress, label removal'; ADR-0017 point 8 and the plan template 4 say the issue returns to In Review. This file follows point 8 (In Progress -> In Review).
humans are not listed for this row in ADR-0017 point 11; not added here

transitions.approval: PROPOSED ASSUMPTION - REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL (ADR-0017 point 11: any -> To Do, human, reason)
proposed_assumptions: 'any' is enumerated as the non-Done statuses; Done -> To Do is the reopen transition

transitions.approval: approved: Done only by a human, needing validation, required review, acceptance-criteria evidence and merge/release conditions; human approval for sensitive work
proposed_assumptions: field names and the exact list of evidence fields are this file's choice, derived from the approved decision, plan template 7 and the plan's Definition of Done
restricted to In Review -> Done (the required review has happened); ADR-0017 point 11 says 'any -> Done' for humans
release condition = release_ref or an explicit no_release_required=true because no release exists yet (ADR-0017 point 10, RELEASED row)
sensitive_work must be stated explicitly; when true, human_approval_ref is required

transitions.approval: PROPOSED ASSUMPTION - REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL (ADR-0017 point 11: Done -> any, human only, reason)

status_unchanged_events.approval: approved in principle: BLOCKED is a comment/label, status unchanged
proposed_assumptions: comment form 'BLOCKED: <reason>' (ADR-0017 point 10); automation is not listed and is denied; no label name is decided
